name: The Malkin Tower Coven
summary: The site of one of the most famous alleged coven gatherings in English history, set against the moody backdrop of Pendle Hill.
lore: On Good Friday in 1612, a group gathered at Malkin Tower, the home of Elizabeth Southerns ('Old Demdike'). Two rival families of folk healers and cunning folk had assembled for a feast. Local magistrate Roger Nowell claimed it was a secret coven plotting to blow up Lancaster Castle and free imprisoned matriarchs. The meeting triggered the notorious Pendle Witch Trials, resulting in ten executions and shaping the archetype of the English witch.
